details:
Description

Since last night, trying to open attached log files from in-client bug reports with log file links (https://api.vrchat.cloud/1/file/{fileId}) on VRChat Feedback fails with 403 Forbidden, even for log files you have submitted yourself.

This affects multiple people, while logged in to VRChat Home. `{"error":{"message":"Forbidden","status_code":403}}`

An example where log files from in-client bug reporting were used to triage a bug (cannot be accessed anymore): https://feedback.vrchat.com/bug-reports/p/worlds-wont-work-or-avatars

Reproduction Steps

Visit https://feedback.vrchat.com/bug-reports and find an in-client bug report. You're looking at one right now!

To create an in-client bug report:

1. Launch VRChat 2026.3.1 `Build 1885` or later.

2. Open the Quick Menu, press Report a Bug.

3. Submit an in-client bug report with "Include log file" enabled.

Details

- Category: Other

- Frequency: Always
